DryingModeEnumeration.description: The drying mode determines the drying process.

BATCH.description: The granulate in the dryer is dried for a certain period of time and then switched to drying protection.

CONTINUOUS.description: The granulate in the dryer is dried continuously.

COMBINED.description: The very wet granulate in the dryer is dried for a certain period of time, after which it is dried continuously.
